g.text: Monorepo — route, browser membership and platform enforcement
Allow only enumerated public GET/HEAD reads,
or exact /v1/op with operator credential; otherwise 401
Identity mode requires identity and request lacks browser/key/dev identity?
Require SameOrigin for methods other than GET/HEAD/OPTIONS
Read selected role or query current membership
Missing membership rejects with 403 except access/account-discovery routes
For key/checkout/portal management and plan POST require owner/admin
Source-reviewed orchestration. Nested semantics remain open; no runtime acceptance
claimed. Complete middleware reviewed. SameOrigin compares supplied Origin
scheme/authority against current request; without Origin it accepts Sec-Fetch-Site=same-
origin or X-Laplace-Request=1. Public routes still reject a supplied invalid key. Webhook
bypass here is not webhook-signature verification. Header mode permits unresolved header
tenants; deployment mode is configuration, not inferred from source.
